en-US.title: It is time for teenagers' original songs to resonate throughout the world
en-US.description:
2026 5th Blossom Youth Music Festival

🎤 Eligibility: Any youth born between 2008 and 2014 (Individual/Team)

🎼 Contest Categories: Any genre! Original compositions of approximately 3 minutes in length

🎁 Unprecedented Benefits

- Release of all finalist tracks

- Appearance on Dingo Music and artist collaboration (Special Award)

- FNC expert mentoring & Total prize money of 15 million KRW

📅 Application Period: May 15, 2026 (Fri) ~ June 30, 2026 (Tue) 23:59

✅ How to Apply: Upload a live video to YouTube, then submit via Google Form

🔗 For more details? Search 'Blossom Youth Music Festival' on Naver! (Refer to the official blog)

https://blog.naver.com/music_blossom

🎥 Source. @blossom.festa @lovefnc_official

#BlossomYouthMusicFestival #SKBroadband #LOVEFNC #Dreamus #DingoMusic
